rail.label: Setup progress
rail.tagline: A few quick questions and we'll fill your first word list.

welcome.title:
Welcome to Ladu
let's create your first Words and Tags.
welcome.text: Answer a few short questions and we'll automatically add words with translations in all your languages, so you can start practicing straight away. It takes about a minute.

languages.title: Pick the languages to include
languages.text: Two or more — you can add more later.

levels.title: Tell us your level
levels.text: A rough guess is perfectly fine.

topics.title: Choose your interests
topics.text: We make a selection of words related to them.

languages.title: Which languages do you want us to use?
languages.hint: We'll include translations in every language you select here in the words we create for you. You need to select at least two.
languages.nativeHint: Ladu adds words to learn in your other languages. Choose “None” to learn all of them.

levels.title: What is your level?
levels.hint: Choose one level for each language. A guess is fine.
levels.intermediateHint: Common words and some less common ones.

topics.title: What interests you?
topics.hint: We'll add a mix of words related to the terms you pick here.

count.title: How many words?
count.hint: You can add or remove words later.
count.hintSmall: A small start. Good to try Ladu.
count.hintMedium: A good start for your first practice sessions.
count.hintLarge: Above 100 words, more general vocabulary is added.
count.capacity: With these levels and topics, we can add up to {{count}} words.
count.capacityLow: With these levels and topics, we can add only {{count}} words. Pick other topics or levels to add more.
count.none: With these levels and topics, we cannot add words. Go back and change them.

result.label: Your new words
result.title: {{words}} words added in {{topics}} topics
result.text: Each topic has its own tag. You can rename or delete the tags like any other tag.
